console.federation.reading.title: Reading settings of the instance
console.federation.reading.hint: Limits for the posts that accounts receive from followed actors. A change applies to new work; it deletes nothing at once. The size limits are in MiB.
console.federation.reading.mention_rate_: Mentions for each domain in one hour
console.federation.retention.title: Retention of received posts
console.federation.retention.hint: Received posts older than this period are deleted. Starred posts and posts that you took into the knowledge base stay. Your value cannot be more than the instance value.
console.storage.state.title: State of the media store
console.storage.state.last_test: Last test of the object storage
console.storage.state.hint: Local storage is the default and needs no setting. With object storage, a file that is not in the bucket is read from local storage. The backup of the data directory does not copy the bucket: make the backup of the bucket on the storage server.
console.storage.form.title: Object storage settings
console.storage.form.hint: A change takes effect at the next start of the api process. Claire does not make the bucket: make the bucket and the key on the storage server first. After a change from object storage to local storage, the media in the bucket stay there.
console.storage.field.endpoint_hint: The S3 API address (Garage: port 3900). https is necessary; http is possible only for a private address in development.
console.storage.field.bucket_hint: A bucket that exists. Path-style addressing is used.
console.storage.field.region_hint: The region of the server (Garage: garage). Empty means us-east-1.
console.storage.field.secret_key_hint: Stored encrypted and never shown. Leave empty to keep the stored key.
console.storage.field.public_url_base_hi: Empty by default: media goes through the media host of Claire.
console.storage.migration.title: Migration from local storage
console.storage.migration.hint: The migration runs from the command line: claire media migrate --to object-storage (a dry run), then with --apply. This page shows the result of the last run with --apply.
console.storage.msg.saved: Saved. The change takes effect at the next start of the api process.
console.storage.msg.test_ok: The test passed: write, read with a byte range, head, and delete.
console.storage.msg.test_failed: The test failed at this operation:
console.storage.msg.not_configured: The object storage settings are not complete. Save the endpoint, the bucket, the access key, and the secret key first.
console.storage.msg.network: The request did not complete because of a network error.
context.doc.model_tip: The model of the latest ingestion of this document. The summary, the detail, and the entities are its outputs; they do not replace the source text, and a new ingestion can make them again with a different model.
